raw_text: In the third drone incursion along the Punjab international border in a week, BSF personnel shot down a Pakistani hexacopter near Amritsar carrying five kilograms of heroin with an estimated street value of Rs 25 crore. The drone was detected at approximately 0030 hours by ground surveillance systems and engaged by BSF troops. Intelligence agencies have identified a narco-terror network operating from Kasur district in Pakistan's Punjab province. The BSF has deployed anti-drone systems at vulnerable forward posts and is working with Punjab Police's anti-narcotics cell to dismantle the receiving network on the Indian side.
clean_text: BSF shot down third drone in a week near Amritsar with 5kg heroin worth Rs 25 crore. Narco network from Pakistan's Kasur identified. Anti-drone systems deployed at forward posts.
